comment: Shape only: frame bodies are placeholders for E1's protocol. SEC-12: handshake g1, wait for the harness to restart the VM (it touches /run/nfx/go-g2 when g2 is up), then send a stale ready and mark. SEC-21: handshake, then ONE invalid frame per run (oversize, truncated, unknown type, duplicate or stale channel ID, ports [0] / [70000] / 10k entries / another scope's port, snapshot ID ../../x, restore fields with markup/ANSI/newlines) and stay connected.
